reply_text:
I can't find Driftmoor's night-dispatch contact in anything you can see. The channels you're in (#coastal-team, #coastal-random, #general, #help-it-ops) don't name one. Kwame's 19 October request in #coastal-team asks for the contact's name in the event notes, but he didn't include it.

Kwame is the person to ask, since the name may be in his own notes or on the Driftmoor account record. Once you have it, I can help with the patch note email, though the address would need to be a pemberline.com address unless Ruth Calloway approves otherwise.
